title: Marlowe & Finch Alterations Price Schedule by Service Class
content:
Marlowe & Finch Alterations prices every ticket from the price schedule of the service class that covers the garment. Each class has its own scope of work, its own garment types and its own operation prices; the schedule below is the complete list for all six classes.

## 1. Scope and garments covered

| Service class | Kind of work the class covers | Garments accepted in the class |
|---|---|---|
| Express Hem & Cuff | hems and plain sleeve shortening while you shop | trousers, jeans, skirts, shirts; only operations on this price list |
| Standard Alterations | everyday fit adjustments to casual and work wear | trousers, skirts, dresses, shirts, knitwear, casual jackets |
| Tailored Suiting | suit, sport coat and overcoat tailoring | suit jackets, suit trousers, sport coats, overcoats; with a measuring appointment |
| Formal & Evening Wear | gowns, cocktail dresses and tuxedos | gowns, cocktail dresses, tuxedos; with a measuring appointment |
| Bridal Alterations | bridal gowns, veils and bridal party dresses | bridal gowns, veils, bridesmaid dresses; with a measuring appointment and a recorded needed-by date |
| Leather & Specialty | leather, suede and embellished garments | leather, suede, beaded or sequined garments bought at Marlowe & Finch |

## 2. Operation prices (USD)

| Service class | Operations and prices |
|---|---|
| Express Hem & Cuff | plain hem 18.00; cuffed hem 24.00; blind-stitched hem 22.00; plain sleeve shortening 24.00 |
| Standard Alterations | plain hem 18.00; cuffed hem 24.00; taking in a waist 28.00; letting out a waist 32.00; plain sleeve shortening 24.00; tapering trouser legs 38.00; taking in the side seams 34.00 |
| Tailored Suiting | shortening suit jacket sleeves 38.00; shortening jacket sleeves with working buttons 65.00; taking in a jacket 55.00; cuffed suit trouser hem 26.00; adjusting a suit trouser waist 32.00; adjusting jacket shoulders 95.00 |
| Formal & Evening Wear | single-layer gown hem 85.00; multi-layer gown hem 145.00; taking in a bodice 75.00; adjusting straps 28.00; tuxedo trouser hem 28.00 |
| Bridal Alterations | multi-layer bridal hem 225.00; adding a bustle 95.00; taking in a bridal bodice 125.00; adjusting bridal sleeves or straps 65.00; shortening a veil 45.00 |
| Leather & Specialty | shortening leather sleeves 85.00; leather hem 95.00; replacing a zipper 65.00; beaded or sequined hem 120.00 |

## 3. Other price-list terms

| Term | Express Hem & Cuff | Standard Alterations | Tailored Suiting | Formal & Evening Wear | Bridal Alterations | Leather & Specialty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lined-garment surcharge (percent of operation prices when the garment is lined) | 20 | 20 | 0 | 25 | 0 | 0 |
| Final pressing included | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Garments not bought at Marlowe & Finch accepted | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | no |
| Garments covered by one ticket | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |

In every class sales tax on alteration charges follows the rules of the store's state and is included in the listed prices, and the price list that applies to a ticket is the price list in force on the drop-off date.

## Reading the schedule

- A price is per operation: a ticket listing a plain hem and taking in a waist in Standard Alterations lists 18.00 USD and 28.00 USD as two operation charges.
- The lined-garment surcharge is a percentage of operation prices that applies only when the garment is lined; a class showing 0 adds nothing for lining.
- Hypothetical illustration: a tuxedo bought elsewhere is accepted in Formal & Evening Wear, because that class accepts garments not bought at Marlowe & Finch; a suede jacket bought elsewhere is not accepted in Leather & Specialty, because that class shows "no".
